MERGE INTO BILL_CLOSE_USER_LIST A USING ( SELECT (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) AS LEGACY_USER_ID, #{issue_date} AS BILL_CLOSE_MONTH, 'LG' AS CLOSE_TYPE, #{buyer_code} AS BUYER_CODE, #{agent_code} AS AGENT_CODE FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.LEGACY_USER_ID = B.LEGACY_USER_ID AND A.BILL_CLOSE_MONTH = B.BILL_CLOSE_MONTH AND A.CLOSE_TYPE = B.CLOSE_TYPE AND A.BUYER_CODE = B.BUYER_CODE AND A.AGENT_CODE = B.AGENT_CODE ) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( LEGACY_USER_ID, BILL_CLOSE_MONTH, CLOSE_TYPE, SEQ, KEP_DEPT, BUYER_CODE, AGENT_CODE, CLOSE_CMPL_YN ) VALUES ( (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}), #{issue_date}, 'LG', (SELECT NVL(MAX(SEQ),0) +1 FROM BILL_CLOSE_USER_LIST WHERE LEGACY_USER_ID = (SELECT LEGACY_USER_ID FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = #{st_user_id}) AND BILL_CLOSE_MONTH = #{issue_date} AND CLOSE_TYPE = 'LG' ), #{dept_code}, #{buyer_code}, #{agent_code}, 'N' )
